name: David Brock Smith

bio.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, Brock Smith lists his occupation as State Senator and small business owner.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition)

bio.statement: His pamphlet statement lists prior work as a state representative, county commissioner, small business owner and economic development director.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition)

bio.statement: The Oregon Legislature lists Brock Smith as a Republican senator for District 1, based in Port Orford, and as Senate Deputy Leader.
bio.excerpt: Republican - District 1 - Port Orford - Deputy Leader

positions.statement: Brock Smith's pamphlet statement says he opposed the governor's gas tax and new tax increases.
